info.title: Legal Contract Analysis API
info.description: AI-powered legal contract analysis. Orchestrates four Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents to extract clauses, assess risk, check regulatory compliance, and synthesize an executive report.

post.description: Submit the full text of a legal contract for AI-powered analysis. Returns an executive report covering key clauses, a risk assessment with an overall risk score, regulatory compliance status, recommended actions, and an approve/review/reject recommendation. Optionally accepts a specific question to answer about the contract instead of producing a general summary.

schema.description: The contract to analyze and an optional question about it.

contract_text.description: The full plain text of the legal contract to analyze. Required.

user_question.description: Optional specific question to answer about the contract, for example 'Is our liability actually capped?'. When omitted, a full executive summary is returned instead of a targeted answer.

schema.description: The analysis report plus per-agent execution status.

status.description: Overall outcome of the request, either success or error.

contract_analysis.description: The synthesized analysis produced by the response agent.

status.description: Outcome reported by the response agent.

summary_response.description: The formatted analysis report in Markdown, covering key clauses, risks, compliance status, recommendations, and a decision recommendation.

agent_type.description: Identifier of the agent that produced the report.

includes_user_question.description: True when the report answers a specific supplied question rather than providing a general summary.

agent_results.description: Per-agent execution status, useful for confirming that all four agents ran rather than the request degrading to a partial answer.

clause_agent.description: Status of the clause extraction agent.

risk_agent.description: Status of the risk assessment agent.

compliance_agent.description: Status of the compliance checking agent.

response_agent.description: Status of the response synthesis agent.

agent_runtime.description: ARN of the response agent runtime that produced the report.

400.description: Invalid input, typically a missing contract_text field

401.description: Unauthorized, invalid or missing OAuth token

500.description: Internal server error while invoking the agent runtimes
